test_title: PYST 3: SSC CGL 2023 - Reasoning (Held on: 06 March 2023)
subject: reasoning
question:
In this question, the statement is followed by two conclusions. Which of the two conclusion(s) is/are true?

**Statement: **Z > F ≥ A = B = G > S < E

**Conclusions:**

I. Z < A

II. G < F

options.text: Both conclusions I and II are true.
Neither conclusion I nor II is true.

solution:
The given statement is: Z > F ≥ A = B = G > S 
 
• Z > F
 
• F ≥ A
 
• A = B
 
• B = G
 
• G > S
 
• S 

**Conclusion:**

I) Z Z > F ≥ A &r
